apps.localizedDescription:
Features:

• Crossplatform (Android, iOS).
• Browse posts and pools.
• Edit posts.
• Comment on posts.

• Favorite, Up and down vote posts.
• Follow tags with notifications.
• Local blacklist.
• DText parsing.
• Video support.
• Multiple logins.
• Multiple App Themes.
